objective: Determine whether ongoing production HOT->COLD rollover is ACTUALLY automated right now, post-cutover -- an actual live, scheduled invoker, not merely the existence of qualified capability code.

traces_performed.finding: Exactly 4 crontab entries exist. None invoke p5b_delta_reconciler.py, transfer_archival_cursor.py, or any COLD-segment-building function. The only storage-related entry is the P2.2 allowlist cleanup job, which is explicitly NOT HOT->COLD archival (confirmed by reading src/ops/storage_lifecycle_runner.py's scope and by its NORMAL/0-executed log output in Part 9).

Grepped config/supervisor/supervisord.conf for 'p5b_delta_reconciler', 'transfer_archival_cursor', 'cold_segment', 'transfer_cold_store', 'close_segment' -- zero matches. No supervisord-managed program runs any transfer archival logic on any schedule.

traces_performed.trace: src/core/operation_scheduler.py (the actual operation_scheduler.py in this repo, confirmed at src/core/, not scripts/)
traces_performed.finding: Grepped for 'archival', 'cold_segment', 'p5b_delta', 'reconcil' -- the only match is 'reconcile_armed' (src.core.operation_armed.reconcile_armed), which is ARMED-pipeline state reconciliation, unrelated to transfer_index HOT/COLD storage. operation_scheduler.py does NOT touch transfer archival in any way.
Checked ~/Library/LaunchAgents/ for any flex-related plist and `launchctl list | grep flex` -- zero results. No launchd job exists for this project.

traces_performed.trace: repo-wide grep for actual invocations of the reconciler/archival modules outside their own definitions
traces_performed.finding: Only 4 files reference these module names: src/ops/p5b_delta_reconciler.py and src/ops/transfer_archival_cursor.py (the modules themselves) plus 3 test files (tests/test_storage_lifecycle_p4_archival_cursor.py, tests/test_storage_lifecycle_p5b_r1_writer_quiesce.py, tests/test_storage_lifecycle_p5b_stage2_parts7_21.py, tests/test_storage_lifecycle_p5b_r2_1_final_recensus.py). No production script, cron entry, or supervisord program imports or calls these modules outside of tests and the qualification/migration work already done for P5A/P5B.

evidence_summary: Exhaustive trace across crontab, supervisord.conf, operation_scheduler.py, launchd, and repo-wide grep for actual call sites found zero live, scheduled invocation of any HOT->COLD archival capability. The qualified infrastructure (P5BDeltaReconciler, ColdSegmentRegistry, transfer_cold_store.py's close_segment/build functions) exists and is fully qualified from P5A/P5B manual migration work, but nothing currently invokes it on a recurring basis in production. COLD is confirmed static since cutover (Part 8: 45 segments / 1,746,519 rows, unchanged) -- this is consistent with and further confirms the absence of automation, since if any rollover were running, COLD would have grown by now.
gap_note: Per Part 15 policy, this gap alone does not indicate the cutover failed -- HOT reads/writes, COLD reads, and all canonical-state checks are healthy independent of whether ongoing archival exists. However, per the milestone's explicit automation-gap retention policy, this absence means the rollback DB must be RETAINED until the automation contract is at least qualified (see storage_lifecycle_p5c_hot_cold_automation_contract.json for the design-only response), not merely to reclaim its 15.4GB immediately.
